A fetch Response has no `.data` property, so with credential sharing enabled `tokenInfo.data` is undefined and `tokenInfo.data.error` throws, breaking the Bigin refresh flow. judged_text: In credential-sync mode refreshOAuthTokens returns a fetch Response, but the Zoho Bigin caller immediately evaluates tokenInfo.data.error, which only exists on an axios response object. With credential sharing enabled, a Zoho Bigin token refresh throws 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading error)' because Response.data is undefined, crashing the Bigin calendar service instead of refreshing tokens.
